report.answer_text:
December 25, 2021 is the most recent Christmas Day I could verify that snow or sleet fell in England. The Met Office recorded it in the Midlands and also reported snow in the Yorkshire Dales. The UK’s more recent official white Christmas, in 2023, was recorded in Scotland, not England. (metoffice.gov.uk)
If you mean widespread snow already on the ground, the last Christmas like that was December 25, 2010. (metoffice.gov.uk)

quotes.text: The last widespread white Christmas in the UK was in 2010.
It was extremely unusual, as not only was there snow on the ground at 83% of stations (the highest amount ever recorded) but snow or sleet also fell at 19% of stations.
There has only been a widespread covering of snow on the ground (where more than 40% of stations in the UK reported snow on the ground at 9 am) four times since 1960 - in 1981, 1995, 2009 and 2010.

pages.quote_reason: The quotes back that the last widespread white Christmas in the UK was in 2010 and that snow covered the ground at 83% of stations, but they never state the specific date of December 25, 2010.
